correctness.rationale: For every pure strategy profile on bidirected loopless K_(a,b), the functional digraph has disjoint cycle components. With multiple cycles, a cycle vertex can redirect to a vertex of the opposite part on another cycle and eliminate its own recurrence, strictly reducing its full-support-prior cost. With one cycle but an off-cycle vertex at depth d≥2, a parity-correct cycle vertex can redirect to that tail to extend the cycle by d (even d) or d−1 (odd d), reducing its cost. Conversely with one cycle of length 2k and only depth-one noncycle vertices, every legal cycle-vertex deviation yields a cycle no longer than the original, and offcycle players have zero cost. Thus the precise prior-free equilibria are one alternating cycle and depth-one attachments. Choose k vertices per side, k!(k−1)! cyclic orders, and k^(a+b−2k) depth-one links to derive the exact labeled N_k. Balanced m,m log count has uniform Stirling exponent F(x) strictly concave and maximized at α=1/(1+ω), ωe^ω=1; concentration of K_m/m and fairness m/K_m follow. Independent exhaustive direct uniform-prior best-response comparisons for K_(1,1), K_(1,4), K_(2,3), K_(3,3), K_(3,4) matched structure and complete coefficients.
